$description: Exaggeration tokens - Disney's principle of amplifying motion for clarity and impact. Multipliers for scale, distance, and timing.

subtle.$description: Minimal exaggeration. Professional, enterprise, serious contexts.

moderate.$description: Standard exaggeration. Consumer apps, general UI.

expressive.$description: Pronounced exaggeration. Playful, gaming, creative apps.

dramatic.$description: Maximum exaggeration. Hero moments, celebrations, landing pages.

cartoon.$description: Cartoon-level exaggeration. Character animation, kids apps.

micro-interaction.$description: Buttons, toggles, ripples. Keep subtle to avoid distraction.

state-change.$description: Tab switches, expansions, reveals. Clear but not overwhelming.

notification.$description: Alerts, toasts, badges. Needs attention, deserves emphasis.

celebration.$description: Success states, achievements, milestones. Maximum impact.

error.$description: Error states. Noticeable but not alarming. Avoid anxiety-inducing exaggeration.

elegant.$description: Luxury, premium, sophisticated brands. Restraint is elegance.

professional.$description: Enterprise, B2B, productivity tools. Functional clarity.

friendly.$description: Consumer apps, social platforms. Approachable warmth.

playful.$description: Gaming, kids, creative tools. Joy and energy.

bold.$description: Disruptor brands, marketing sites. Make a statement.

introduction.$description: Opening moments. Build interest, set expectations.

climax.$description: Peak moment. Pull out all stops.

resolution.$description: After climax. Return to calm, satisfaction.

realistic-vs-stylized.$description: Spectrum from realistic to stylized motion

stylized.$description: Clearly stylized but believable. Most UI animation.

cartoon.$description: Full cartoon physics. Impossible but delightful.
